The '''Maphus Tria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Maphus Tria]].
